# db-15 — DataBall export must support profiles and content splits

`ExportAsync` takes a named profile and an optional split. Four profiles are bundled, and more come from an `exportProfiles` section in `Config`. A split can use `by` expressions, `routes`, a `files` or `hive` layout, `maxRows` and `maxSplits`. Every output is staged under `<out>/.databall-staging/<id>/` and moved into place only after all of them succeed. Each export writes `<out>/_manifest/<id>.json`. Squish's hive output goes through the same writer.

**Findings:** owner interview (2026-10-08) · **Size:** M · **Tree:** databall

**2026-10-10** — Owner decision 2026-10-10 (spec interview): four bundled profiles plus exportProfiles in Config; staging at <out>/.databall-staging/<id>/; manifest at <out>/_manifest/<id>.json.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:** `overwrite: version`; C# split strategies; quarantine and watch folders (not planned); folding `ExportType` into the options (db-16); `.ball` saves (`SaveAsync` is not an export).

## Why

`docs/conflux-spec.md` ("Export"): named profiles (`parquet-zstd` default with row group 122,880, `parquet-snappy`, `csv-plain`: comma, UTF-8 without BOM, LF, ISO dates; `csv-excel`: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF), each able to set renames, column order and selection, CSV dialect, `fileNameTemplate` and `overwrite`; content splits; staged commit so a failed run never leaves partial outputs; a manifest with inputs, outputs (path, rows, bytes, schema), status and timings. Suite `docs/databall-v1.4-alignment.md`: "Profiles + splits extend export".

Owner decision 2026-10-10 (spec interview): bundled profiles plus `exportProfiles` in `Config`; staging at `<out>/.databall-staging/<id>/`; manifest at `<out>/_manifest/<id>.json`.

Today: `ExportAsync(path, ExportType)` (`src/DataBall/DataBall.cs:464`) writes one file with `COPY` (`src/DataBall/DuckDbStore.cs:1056`) and honors `ApplyFilter`. Hive output is `ExportPartitionedParquet` (`:967`), which refuses to clear a directory holding anything but hive folders and Parquet files (`ClearHiveTarget`, `:981`).

## Files

- `src/DataBall/Export/ExportProfile.cs` (new): `Format` (`csv`, `parquet`), `Compression`, `RowGroupSize`, CSV (`Delimiter`, `Bom`, `NewLine` `lf`/`crlf`, `DateFormat`), `Columns` (selection and order), `Rename`, `FileNameTemplate` (default `{name}_{date:yyyyMMdd}.{ext}`, plus split names), `Overwrite` (`replace` default, matching today's behavior; `fail`). The four bundled profiles. Where DuckDB `COPY` has no option (BOM, CRLF), the staged file is post-processed with a streaming copy; first check which options `COPY ... (FORMAT csv)` supports in DuckDB 1.5.5.
- `src/DataBall/Export/SplitSpec.cs` (new): `By` (name + SQL expression), `Routes` (name, `when`, optional `path` relative to the output directory; first match wins; an `else` route is required; a path that escapes the output directory throws), `Layout` (`files`, `hive`), `MaxRows` (adds `_part{n}`), `MaxSplits` (default 10,000; checked with one `count(DISTINCT ...)` before anything is written).
- `src/DataBall/Export/ExportOptions.cs` (new): `Profile` (default `parquet-zstd`), `Split`, `Name` (default `data`). `ExportAsync(string outputDirectory, ExportOptions options)`; the `ExportType` overload stays until db-16.
- `src/DataBall/Export/ExportRun.cs` (new): the id (`yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ-<8 hex>`), staging, commit (with `fail`, every target is checked before anything moves), cleanup on failure, and the manifest: id, status, start and end UTC, DataBall version, resolved profile, split, sources when the session has a `source` dimension (db-11), outputs (relative path, rows, bytes, schema), and the error when it failed. A failed export still writes its manifest. An internal test hook fails the Nth output.
- `src/DataBall/Config.cs`: `ExportProfiles` (name → profile; overlay wins by name, including over bundled names); merge and clone.
- `src/DataBall/DataBall.cs`: `Bounce`/`Squish` hive output goes through `ExportRun` with `Layout = hive`, keeping `ClearHiveTarget`'s refusal rule.
- `src/DataBall.Cli/CommandFactory.cs`: `export` gains `--profile`, repeatable `--split-by name=expr` and `--hive`.
- `README.md` (new "Export profiles" section, "CLI") and `docs/how-it-works.md`.
- Tests: new `tests/DataBall.Tests/ExportProfileTests.cs`; existing `BounceSquishTests` stay green.
- No new dependencies.

## Must not change

- `ExportAsync(path, ExportType)` output for CSV, Parquet and archive is unchanged until db-16 folds it: same files, header and default codec.
- Squish and Bounce hive output: same directory layout, the `WRITE_PARTITION_COLUMNS` behavior, and `ClearHiveTarget`'s refusal to clear a directory with foreign files. Every `BounceSquishTests` case passes unchanged.
- `ApplyFilter` keeps applying to CSV, Parquet and archive exports, and never to `.ball` saves.
- A failed export never leaves partial final outputs and never deletes files it did not stage.
